title: Evidence-Governed Material Pressure Runtime
objective: Apply ADR-026 qualification to governed Enterprise intelligence while preserving uncertainty, contradictions, lineage and commercial-governance boundaries.
implementation_summary: Flora now applies the accepted ADR-026 qualification contract to governed Enterprise intelligence, allowing evidence-grounded Material Pressures to become part of durable Enterprise understanding while preserving uncertainty, contradictions, lineage and commercial-governance boundaries.
expected_visible_outcomes: No normal Enterprise dossier exposes raw AI or OSS/BSS semantic-field labels.
Executive signals use the governed fact itself rather than generic transformation boilerplate.
Advanced Inspection shows deterministic Executive Intelligence Quality diagnostics for all six Enterprises.
The Key Reports four-state model, Programme singularity and Opportunity/procurement distinction remain unchanged.
unchanged_areas: Protected: Evidence provenance and applicability; 308 Relationships; 13 Programmes; 17 Opportunities; Key Reports four-state semantics; candidate governance; TEL-001 fixture.
required_test_steps: Open all six Enterprise dossiers and compare them side by side.
Confirm no raw Ai: or AI: field labels appear in normal dossier presentation.
Confirm Organisation, Strategy, Operating Model, Technology and Change sections use Enterprise-specific governed intelligence where supplied.
Confirm Financial Position and Key Reports retain their existing four-state outcomes.
Confirm Programmes remain singular, Opportunities do not become procurements, and Unknowns and Contradictions remain visible.
fresh_import_policy: NO — ADR-026 reasoning operates over already-imported canonical TEL-001 intelligence.
known_limitations: TEL-001 supplies no qualifying BT external analyst, broker, equity-research or market-research report; the runtime therefore shows a truthful empty state.
Evidence availability does not promote unextracted report content into canonical Enterprise facts.
Enterprise Economics and Leadership / Governance remain architectural intent, not independently implemented TEL-001 runtime dimensions.
